description: Use this when the user asks about reservation policy, fees, pets, fires, facilities, or park descriptions, such as 'does X allow dogs' or 'when do reservations open'. Verified policy knowledge currently covers BC Parks only; other systems return an explicit unsupported answer with the official source. Specify system or province for general policy questions; without a park or system the scope is BC Parks. Do not use it for availability (parksopen_search_campsites) or current closures (parksopen_check_alerts).

park.description: park name, when the question is about one park

province.description: province code or prefix, e.g. bc

question.description: what you want to know (fees, pets, fires, showers, reservations policy…)

name: parksopen_park_info
title: Park facts, rules and fees (knowledge base)
